title: Alltarach
author: Katie Canning and Josef Olsson
description:
An illustrated interactive novel about family, folklore, and grief, set in a semi-historical version of 6th century Ireland.

Author's Comment: "This game is part character study, part playful take on Irish mythology, part love letter to my home country. I'm really proud of what our little team has managed to accomplish with enough hacking of Harlowe. Bainigí sult as — enjoy!"
